title: Jordan Chiles, two-time Olympic gymnast, announces return for run at L.A. Games
content:
American Jordan Chiles is returning to gymnastics, the two-time Olympian announced Wednesday, making a run for the Los Angeles Games in 2028.

Chiles’ decision means that every member of the gold medal-winning Paris squad except Simone Biles has announced a comeback. Biles has not yet made a decision about whether she will return for what would be her fourth Games.

Chiles was a member of the silver medal U.S. women’s team in Tokyo, and came back for gold in Paris. She also won bronze on floor in 2024 before the IOC reallocated the medal to Romania over a dispute involving a score inquiry. Chiles appealed the decision to the Court of Arbitration of Sport, where it is still pending. Chiles also won two NCAA bars titles and two floor titles as a student at UCLA, where she graduated in the spring.

Six-time Olympic medalist Suni Lee announced her comeback in July. Fellow 2021 and 2024 teammate, Jade Carey, returned to elite competition in June, while the fourth member of the Paris squad, Hezly Rivera, recently won her second national championship in the two years since the 2026 Games.

The four will join a field of newcomers and fellow veterans — like six-time World Championship medalist Shilese Jones — in a run for the chance to represent the U.S. in the first home summer Olympics since 1996 in Atlanta. The Washington native spent years training with Biles in Texas, but if Chiles makes the team in 2028, the UCLA graduate would compete in front of a home crowd. On Tuesday, the Bruins announced she would return to UCLA as a student coach.

The next day, Biles announced her comeback in a video on Instagram narrated by Michael Jordan, Chiles’ namesake.

“Why again? Because the dream is still there,” Michael Jordan says as Chiles drives to the beach in Los Angeles. “Why continue? Because there’s still more to give. Why now? Because not every chapter ends when people expect it to. Why her? Because she’s that girl. Some decisions don’t need permission. Just one more bet, on herself.”

The video features singer Normani, whose music Chiles has featured in her floor routines, and model Winnie Harlow.

“So when the world asks why she’s back for a third time, the answer is simple,” Michael Jordan continues.

Then, Chiles flashes a smile with grills that say “LA 2028,” and replies, “Why not?”
